designIntent: One simple, spacious and welcoming game lobby with one reserved full-height playable staircase. F00 provides arrival, atmosphere, orientation, E01 access and Stair A access only; it does not duplicate gameplay or define upper-floor purposes.

authority.coordinateSystem: Unity X/Z horizontal in metres; north/up is +Z

baseSpace.name: Open welcome lobby hall
baseSpace.purpose: The complete F00 public experience: a calm, premium arrival space with clear sightlines, free movement, and obvious paths to E01 and Stair A.
baseSpace.partitionRule: No new programme rooms or enclosed gameplay areas in S4. The one Stair A enclosure is required building circulation infrastructure, not a floor programme room.

anchors.name: Welcome and floor-directory point
anchors.purpose: A small game-facing welcome marker and simple F00-F06 directory; no service desk and no upper-floor purposes assigned yet.

anchors.name: Minimal lounge seating
anchors.purpose: Two restrained seating clusters beside the open hall edges. The west cluster moves south to clear the staircase footprint and approach.

anchors.name: Anatomy-inspired theme feature
anchors.purpose: One abstract decorative centrepiece that communicates the anatomy-game identity without becoming an instructional room or anatomically authoritative model.

anchors.name: E01 elevator lobby
anchors.purpose: A generous uncluttered landing and waiting area around the approved elevator, visible from the entrance.

anchors.name: Biophilic decor pair
anchors.purpose: Two compact planted or sculptural accents along the glazing to soften the lobby without creating additional functions.

anchors.name: Full-height playable Stair A
anchors.purpose: The reserved building-core footprint for one continuous playable switchback staircase serving F00-F06. It is circulation infrastructure and assigns no purpose to an upper floor.

circulation.name: Direct entrance-to-E01 route
circulation.rule: Keep the full route free of counters, seating, displays and theme objects.

stairCirculation.name: Open-lobby-to-Stair-A route
stairCirculation.rule: Keep the route and the east-side stair landing clear of seating, decor and displays.

themeDirection.name: Premium clinical-future welcome
cues: warm off-white and soft stone base
charcoal framing coordinated with the exterior, elevator and stair
blue-grey glass and cool wayfinding light
soft indirect lighting and limited greenery
one anatomy-inspired abstract feature rather than multiple exhibits
themeDirection.deferredToS6: Exact materials, lighting, furniture, signage, planting and sculpture design require later visual approval.

upperFloors.status: F01-F06 PURPOSES REMAIN UNDECIDED; ONLY STAIR A CORE/LANDINGS ARE AUTHORIZED INFRASTRUCTURE AFTER S4 APPROVAL
upperFloors.rule: This S4 plan assigns no content, theme or function to an upper floor. Stair A is shared circulation infrastructure only.

nextStageSequence.name: Full Stair A integration
nextStageSequence.scope: First build and validate the complete playable switchback staircase, openings and landings from F00 through F06 using the approved A06 footprint. Do not begin other F00 greybox work in parallel.

nextStageSequence.name: Remaining F00 greybox walkthrough
nextStageSequence.scope: Only after S5A approval, build the other approved F00 lobby anchors and circulation in neutral greybox form.

nextStageSequence.name: F00 visual design and finish
nextStageSequence.scope: Only after S5B approval, apply approved visual finishes without changing the accepted layout.

reviewQuestions: Is one open welcome hall plus one full-height staircase the correct overall direction for F00?
Is the prior playable Stair A footprint at the west side the correct staircase location?
Does moving the west seating cluster south preserve enough seating without crowding the stair?
Are the E01 and Stair A routes obvious and uncluttered?
Approve V03 as the authority for S5A full staircase integration first, or request a specific correction?
deferred: all S5A staircase geometry until this V03 plan receives explicit user approval
all S5B remaining F00 walls, counters, furniture, collision and playable greybox geometry until S5A approval
all S6 materials, lighting, signage, plants, sculpture and visual finishing
E02 operation, standalone Quest packaging and final performance acceptance
